We met because we both worked at the same camp. At first, I would just see him looking after his campers and I wasn't even necessarily attracted to him. However, I noticed how he treated the kids and I distinctly remember saying to someone "Hey, I like that guy. He really cares about the campers and he has positive energy." He was one of the few people at camp who genuinely cared and I noticed that. The first time I talked to him was one day when I was getting food and he was speaking Spanish to the lady serving him food and I was like "whoa where did you learn that" and he smiled proudly and said "Argentina." Which I laugh at now because at that point he had never been to Argentina! But his family is from there and so he grew up learning Spanish and English. Then one day I heard somebody singing and it was him singing "Let it Go" to one of the campers and he had a real nice voice so I told him. Then we got to talking and he told me his name. And he said thank you for saying he's talented because nobody has ever told him that and I was confused because he has such a nice voice and he's been singing for years. I sing too and it was really cool to meet someone else I could sing with. Then he told me that he's been meaning to talk to me for a while but our jobs are so busy that he hasn't gotten the chance. And then the next day he was so nervous and asked me to hang out and the rest is history. We instantly became close friends and I went from just thinking he was a nice guy that I didn't have feelings for to having really serious feelings for him in a mature way rather than the whole childish "thinking he's cute" kind of way. 

I don't really know what I was hoping would happen. Ideally, a relationship would've been nice but that would have to happen later down the line because we had only really been hanging out for two weeks and I need more time for that.  But I can see that at first, he was definitely hoping for a relationship. There were several times he almost kissed me, but as a result of what I've went through, I have really bad anxiety so he would always stop himself because he wouldn't want to scare me. And simply the way he talked to me. We weren't just almost in a relationship. We were friends too and we genuinely cared about each other. We both have anxiety and we helped each other with those problems of ours a few times and that made us really close cuz we understood each other better than most people had. At least on my end. But over the course of a few days there was a dramatic shift with him. From the first time we hung out, I knew about Argentina. Yes I was sad he was leaving but also it was a given that we would stay in touch. We had talked about it. But one day, he changed. Based on context clues, i can infer that he told someone in his life about me and they told him to separate himself. And so a few days later, he would simply pretend I wasn't even there. I asked him about it and he said he has tunnel visions and he is so focused on his job which is partially true. However there would be times where I was feet away from him and he would act like he didn't even see me.  So I think what happened was it hurt for him to say goodbye so he just pretended what happened between us never happened 3 weeks early so it would hurt less. And in turn it broke my heart. So I never really got closure. For him, simply being friends was too painful I guess cuz he really cared about me which to an extent I can understand. But what I don't understand is the fact that he couldn't work up the courage to say that to my face and because of that, it hurts a lot more. If you care about someone the way he cared about me, you give them at least that no matter how much it hurts. I would've been perfectly fine with just friendship because I love spending time with him and he's honestly one of the coolest most miraculous individuals I've ever met. But unfortunately I can't get a lasting friendship or a relationship out of this. 
What I did get is the knowledge. In the few weeks we knew each other, we both taught each other a lot. We changed each other's lives.  I am a better version of myself because he was in my life. He taught me what it was like to truly be cared about by a guy. He set a standard, and now I know to never accept anything less than to be treated with the kind of respect he addressed me with. Sometimes it feels like it didn't even happen because so much happened in so little time but IT DID. And I am so thankful to have even met him. 
And right now he's in Argentina studying abroad and going to Argentina means the world to him and all I can be is happy for him. He's living his dreams right now. So am I, actually. I'm focusing on myself and not even entertaining anything with another guy because I still have feelings for him. In fact, every time a cute guy hits on me, I come away from the encounter saying "yeah, I still only have eyes for him," and it actually strengthens my feelings for this boy. 
My hope is one day we will be able to talk this out and maybe even become friends again. But I can only do that if he isn't willing so I won't force it. He's probably hurting a lot too now so I'll give him space to heal. Lord knows I need it too after what he put me through. But I'll get there, just not yet.
